summary: TFS Financial Corporation filed an 8-K reporting quarterly results and announcing that its mutual holding company (MHC) received Federal Reserve non-objection to waive dividends on 227,119,132 shares (81% stake) up to $1.27 per share for 12 months ending July 2027. Members approved waiver with 97% of votes cast in favor (59% eligible votes). Previous waiver was $1.13 per share for four quarters ended June 2026. The waiver redirects cash to minority shareholders, effectively increasing per-share distributions. Watch for future dividend declarations and any MHC actions affecting the 81% ownership overhang.
